title: Defaulted list lookup and casting
statement: For any modulus $k\in\mathbb{N}$, list $v$ of natural numbers, and index $j\in\mathbb{N}$, looking up the $j$th entry of the list obtained by casting every entry of $v$ into $\mathbb{Z}/k\mathbb{Z}$, using $0$ if the index is out of range, gives the cast into $\mathbb{Z}/k\mathbb{Z}$ of the $j$th entry of $v$, again using $0$ if the index is out of range.
hypotheses_covered: $v$ is a list of natural numbers
